title: Python and GitHub Actions style guidance: edit the shared skills under .claude/skills, not the removed .claude/rules files
answers: Where are the Python coding and testing conventions stored now?
Where do the GitHub Actions workflow style rules live after the rules-to-skills move?
I need to change a Copilot review instruction for workflows or Python files; which file does it point to?
body:
Path: Style conventions for Python source and tests (`.claude/skills/python-style/SKILL.md`) and for GitHub Actions workflows and composite actions (`.claude/skills/github-actions-style/SKILL.md`) are read by Claude and Copilot review through shared skills; the Copilot entry points are `.github/instructions/python.instructions.md` and `.github/instructions/github-actions.instructions.md`, which link to those SKILL.md files.
Rule: Put new Python or workflow conventions in the matching SKILL.md, keep its frontmatter `name` and `description` (the description is what makes the skill selectable), and update the `.github/instructions/*.instructions.md` link if the path changes. Keep each instructions file's `applyTo` scope unchanged. `.agents/skills` is a symlink to `../.claude/skills`, so the same files are reachable from both trees.
Constraints: Skills must be selected or invoked; this layout does not guarantee that a skill loads for every matching file, and it does not make Copilot discover the skill automatically. Do not recreate `.claude/rules/python.md` or `.claude/rules/github-actions.md`; those were moved, not copied.
applies: Repository-wide for MLflow agent and Copilot guidance on Python and GitHub Actions files.
says: Where do I update the Python coding conventions used by automated code reviews?
Automated review guidelines for workflows point to deleted or moved style rule documents.
Update repository style guidelines for coding assistants and pull request review bots.
The repository coding standards document for Python source and tests is missing.
search: Python and GitHub Actions coding style guidance is maintained in shared skills at .claude/skills/python-style/SKILL.md and .claude/skills/github-actions-style/SKILL.md, linked from Copilot instructions in .github/instructions/python.instructions.md and .github/instructions/github-actions.instructions.md. New conventions belong in the respective SKILL.md files while preserving frontmatter name and description, with .agents/skills providing a symlink to ../.claude/skills. The legacy .claude/rules/python.md and .claude/rules/github-actions.md files were moved and must not be recreated, noting that skill loading is not guaranteed for every file and Copilot does not automatically discover them.
